ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous regions on lateral lobes; a central black butterfly-shaped region concentrated around the notch extending toward the mid-lobe; a distinct, isolated vertical black band on the left lobe; fine black mottling and focal spots clustered near the trailing edge and central axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is deep relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and valleys along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex curve fitted from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear mark on the left lobe; multiple thin, unaligned horizontal and diagonal linear scratches on the right lobe breaking the white pigmentation field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical stripe on the left lobe and multiple horizontal/diagonal rake marks visible on the lower-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique, isolated vertical black band located on the medial-lateral section of the left fluke lobe.
